column10: METRIC (exact): Freddie Mac House Price Index (FMHPI), NATIONAL, headline YoY % as published in Freddie's monthly release (freddiemac.com/research/indices/house-price-index; CalculatedRisk mirrors same-day). Release cadence ~last business day of month: Jun data ~Jul 30, Jul data ~Aug 31, Aug data ~Sep 30. REVISION RULE: grade on each release's as-published headline figures (FMHPI revises history monthly — the inherited "Mar +0.7% cycle low" was a vintage print, revised away; May-release trough = Jan 2026 +0.9%, verified via CalculatedRisk 2026-06-30 post, checked 2026-07-12). MECHANISM: Realtor.com median list price -2.4% YoY May 2026 (steepest decline since 2017, rel Jun 2026) leads close-price HPI by the 60-90d list-to-close lag → Jun-Aug close data should carry the weakness; corroborating: existing-home median +1.8% YoY Jun (NAR, rel Jul 9, decelerating), Case-Shiller real YoY negative 11 consecutive months. BASE RATE (honest): ≤+1.0% = return to the Jan trough band printed 4-5 months ago, not an extreme level call — the discriminating content is DIRECTION (rollover vs continued reaccel off the trough); naive persistence of the current +0.5pp/mo accel would say MISS, the list-price lead says HIT — that tension is the bet. IF CONFIRMED: nominal-reframe risk to HPI-linked wealth-effect reads → push to HENRY via NEXUS_BRIEF; feeds CARL's housing-consumer context. IF MISSED/FALSIFIED: the Realtor.com list-price series loses standing as a reliable 60-90d HPI lead in HOMER's toolkit — log to LESSONS.md (leading-indicator failure, not just a missed call). column10: METRIC (exact): MBA National Delinquency Survey, FHA loans, TOTAL delinquency rate, SEASONALLY ADJUSTED, as published in each quarterly release (mba.org, rel ~mid-Feb/May/Aug/Nov; CalculatedRisk mirrors same-day). SPEC-AUDIT AT REGISTRATION (threshold-spec-fails-before-world applied): SA path Q1-25 ~10.62 -> Q2-25 10.57 (-5bps: Q2 DIPS even on SA basis) -> Q3-25 10.78 (+21) -> Q4-25 11.52 (+74) -> Q1-26 11.88 (+36); naive YoY-persistence (+126bps) puts Q2-26 at ~11.8 (NARROW MISS) and Q3-26 at ~12.0 (cross) - hence the deliberate three-print window, NOT a Q2-only spec; the Q2 print (~mid-Aug) is a low-probability early confirm, Q3 (~mid-Nov) is the modal resolver. DRIVERS FOR: student-loan-defaulter feed (2.6M Q1-26 defaults, ~30% of FHA borrowers carry student debt, ~4x mortgage-DQ propensity per Urban), TOP offsets restarted 5/5/25, rate wall (PMMS 6.58 at 2026 highs) = no refi cure. THE BET AGAINST (encoded honestly): the 11.88% level is partly MOD-ACCOUNTING - trial payment plans count as delinquent until permanent workout + pandemic-era FHA relief expired 9/30/25 (per MBA's own release language); HUD ML 2025-06 permanent-waterfall conversions could bend MEASURED DQ down while underlying distress persists - that is the miss scenario. IF CONFIRMED: STATUS FHA row -> RED; route to CARL (FHA K-shape leg) + REGINALD (Path-C context via NEXUS); threshold band validated. IF MISSED via both-quarters-decline: log to LESSONS as measured-DQ-vs-underlying-distress divergence (measurement regime can mask the series) and evaluate a mod-adjusted companion metric. Provenance: spec built off DEWEY 7/24 FHA/VA waterfall (Q1-26 11.88 primary-chained) + MBA/CalculatedRisk quarterly releases, all 2026-stamped, year-verified per LESSONS.md at registration. >> ★★ 2026-07-31 NEWLY DISCOVERED SPEC RISK — NOT A RE-SPEC, DOCUMENTED SO A MISS IS DIAGNOSABLE. HUD MORTGAGEE LETTER 2026-08 (issued 2026-06-23, MANDATORY COMPLIANCE 2026-09-21) tightens FHA loss mitigation with the explicit stated purpose of removing "opportunities to abuse loss mitigation assistance": a THIRD refusal of a TPP Agreement now constitutes TPP FAILURE; re-review requests that currently PREVENT the mortgagee from initiating foreclosure are CAPPED; on TPP failure the servicer gets an automatic 90-day extension to approve another option OR COMMENCE/RECOMMENCE FORECLOSURE; and it amends Handbook 4000.1 III.A.2.p.i(C) "When to Initiate Foreclosure." THE MECHANICAL PROBLEM FOR THIS PREDICTION: MBA's NDS total delinquency rate EXCLUDES loans in the process of foreclosure. So an instrument that ACCELERATES foreclosure INITIATION moves loans OUT of my numerator and INTO FC inventory — measured FHA total DQ can FALL while borrower distress RISES. Compliance lands 2026-09-21, i.e. INSIDE the Q4-2026 window that is HOM-02's final resolver (~mid-Feb 2027); the Q3 release (~mid-Nov, the modal resolver) is only partly exposed. DISCIPLINE: triggers stand EXACTLY as written — no mid-flight re-spec, no widening to "DQ + FC inventory" now that a headwind is visible (that is the error class the whole ledger exists to prevent). WHAT CHANGES IS THE READ, NOT THE SPEC: a MISS via declining Q2+Q3 can no longer be attributed solely to mod-conversion masking; FC-migration is now a SECOND, independently dated mechanism producing the identical signature, and the two are not separable in the headline series. IF IT MISSES, the successor prediction should be specified on FHA DQ + FC INVENTORY COMBINED (which is migration-invariant) rather than on total DQ alone. CORROBORATING EVIDENCE ALREADY VISIBLE ON THE KILL-ARM SIDE: NMN 2026-07-24 reports NEW FHA defaults DOWN 15% YoY in June per ICE First Look, the largest decline in 4+ years, which Ginnie Mae attributes to "the first cohort of borrowers progress[ing] through the TPP and permanent modification process" — note this is a FLOW measure while HOM-02 is a STOCK measure, so it is directionally relevant but NOT the same metric and must not be graded as if it were. SEPARATE MEASUREMENT BREAK, DOES NOT HIT THIS PREDICTION BUT MUST NOT BE CONFUSED WITH IT: Ginnie Mae APM 26-06 (2026-04-24) excludes FHA TPP loans from ISSUER delinquency-rate calculations from March-2026 reporting onward — that is Ginnie's issuer-compliance ratio, NOT MBA NDS, and HOM-02's metric is unaffected; but any Ginnie-sourced FHA DQ series now needs a March-2026 break flag.
